columns.name: 1 The following table presents the comparison of Crime Rate vis-a-vis. Arrest Rate and no. of arrests per case for the crimes reported under IPC during 1997. Arrest rate for Property offences such as Burglary & Theft and White collar crimes such as C.B.T., Cheating & Counterfeiting was reported to be lower than their respective crime rates to the extent that not even one person per case was arrested for these crimes. The arrest rate for all other IPC crimes was higher than their respective crime rates. NO. OF ARRESTS PER CASE
